title: fairfig: colour-blind-safe, journal-ready matplotlib figures
description: A matplotlib style and helper library that gives scientific figures one consistent, colour-blind-safe visual identity: Okabe-Ito hues ordered for colour-vision deficiency and set at distinct brightness levels (tested with a colour-blind reader), batlow and vik colour maps for ordered data, exact column widths for ACS, Elsevier and Nature, markers for experiment and lines for models, a bundled monospace font, SVG and PDF export, and built-in colour-blind and greyscale checks.
